text:
Oliver: Heads-up - postmortem follow-up for the recent OOM cluster. Need a compact action list with explicit verification so we can close items. Weekly rotation for status checks until metrics stable.

Mei: I can take the heap-diff work. Plan: nightly heap snapshots + automatic diff against golden baseline. Will add alloc_site and prefix_tag to samples. ETA: 48h.

Samir: I’ll own runtime experiments: try arena-based allocs for small items, and a TTL-based eviction canary (short TTL on cold prefixes). Will run canary in staging and record fragmentation_ratio + tail-latency. ETA: 96h.

Noelle: I’ll implement a fast emergency mitigation: temporarily disable background compaction while eviction is in progress to avoid the compaction+evict race. Also add an opt-in annotation for risky prefixes. ETA: 36h.

Oliver: Great. Please list discrete actions we can mark completed in the postmortem. Keep them small.

Mei: Action-1 (Mei) - add nightly heap snapshot job, push to s3, and wire golden-diff pipeline. Verification: diff job runs for 3 nights with reports. ETA: 48h.

Samir: Action-2 (Samir) - implement arena allocator for small allocations in staging canary; measure CPU/RSS and record perf matrix. Verification: fragmentation_ratio drops by >10% on canary. ETA: 96h.

Noelle: Action-3 (Noelle) - PR to gate compaction during eviction, add unit tests for eviction+compaction concurrency. Verification: stress test no longer reproduces RSS creep. ETA: 36h.

Oliver: Action-4 (Oliver) - short-term guard: per-container hard cap at 88% and a lightweight pre-evict that prefers low-hit prefixes. Verification: no OOMs for 7 days on canary. ETA: 24h.

Mei: Action-5 (Mei) - dashboard: top 25 alloc_sites with prefix_tag, plus a weekly digest to #eng-runtime. Verification: dashboard live + weekly digest posted. ETA: 72h.

Samir: Small example of reproducer pattern I saw in traces - eviction + compaction overlap:
```
// repro harness pseudocode
spawn threads {
  continuously put(random_prefix(), random_payload())
}
periodically {
  evict(prefixes_hot())
  compact()
}
// observe RSS over time
```
I’ll add this to the CI stress suite.

sre-bot: alert rule created: kvcache_rss_delta_v2 - triggers when delta(sum(kv_cache_rss) by (shard), 30m) > 0.12 * container_mem. PagerDuty: on-call -> infra lead.

Noelle: For telemetry, add tags: shard, zone, prefix_bucket, git_rev. Also include last_restart_count in alert context.

Mei: Uploading baseline snapshots now: s3://redwood-profiles/1981234567/mei-baseline-1.pb.gz

Oliver: Who will own weekly check-ins? Need someone to rotate and post minutes.

Samir: I can take weeks 1+2. Noelle takes weeks 3+4. We will attach checks and action updates.

ci-bot: canary deploy started: kvcache-canary-12 (arena_alloc=true, ttl_evict=30s) - build 2026.06.21-rc4.

Noelle: One more: add a synthetic churn job that runs daily and reports churn_score per prefix. If churn_score > 0.25 for 48h -> auto-open ticket. ETA: 48h.

Oliver: Perfect. Please add PR links and test results into the postmortem doc. I’ll draft a 2-slide exec summary after the first round of canary metrics. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
